# Button

Button is the commit control: five variants on a 28, 32 or 40px height, with the primary variant pressing 2px onto a hard lower edge.

`Pathwisse.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<Pathwisse.Button>…</Pathwisse.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="Pathwisse.Button">…</x-import>
```

| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "ghost" \| "stage" \| "danger"` |  |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` |  |
| `stage` | `"learn" \| "practice" \| "build" \| "review" \| "prove"` |  |
| `block` | `boolean` |  |
